text:
```yaml
name: PR Size Labeler

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, edited]

jobs:
  label-pr:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v4
        with:
          go-version: '1.19'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: go mod download

      - name: Run PR size labeler
        run: |
          go run ./scripts/pr-size-labeler.go --pr-number ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }} --repo-name cloudposse/atmos
```
